stories.text:
Humans, Anomalies, and everything else all possess a singular, universal truth—a drive to be perceived; like flocks of birds flashing their feathers, flowers giving off aromas, whales singing into the deep… But beyond that, there's something at our core, something even more uniquely our own, spreading outward from body and mind, crossing the thickest barriers and the deepest voids, ceaselessly proving our existence and uniqueness to the universe.
"Like… a 'frequency,' only tuned differently."
When Linko was having her Esper ability information registered, nearly everyone who dealt with her was left more confused than they started. Nothing the girl described could be verified by any device or theory, and yet they all stated at some point that they could clearly feel—if only for a moment—that they were being connected with, as if resonating on the same frequency as something else… Until Linko would say something she really shouldn't in that innocent, caring, faintly sympathetic voice of hers, and they would hurriedly put their dependable adult masks back on.
"Work's really rough, huh… Why not just jump ship?"
"Cough, cough! No, I can't. And I wasn't even thinking about such things. Next question—"

In the early days after her Esper ability awakened, Linko would often be left dizzy after syncing up with too many frequencies at once—causing her to send the noise flooding into her mind back out again unconsciously, disrupting nearby equipment and people. As a result, the Bureau custom-built a head-mounted device for her to help block out interference and to help her focus. Most people her age might have found its design a little intimidating, but Linko loved it. After her ability awakened, the things she liked—and the reasons she liked them or was drawn to them—only became harder for others to understand, which made it even harder for her to fit in. Fortunately, for a loner like Linko, "not being understood" was never a problem that needed solving.
And yet, one accident long ago introduced her to a new companion, and one act of courage landed her a new responsibility. After facing off against the gloomy, taciturn ETD-6 captain, Linko was approved to become the Guarantor for the Oddity Xiaozhen and was brought into ETD-6 as its youngest member due to a special exception. Exe's judgment was spot-on: Linko's Esper Ability made it far easier for ETD-6 to track down and capture Anomaly-related criminals. Whether it was truly frequencies guiding her, or merely the universe putting her on the right path, Linko's uncanny intuition was vital to cracking major cases regardless. Even so, even after a year in ETD, many people still can't help but worry about her wildly offbeat way of doing things.
"…Um, Linko, aren't we a little too far from the main group?"
"Don't worry. It's the main group that's lost. Trust my intuition!"

stories.title: Hethereau Love Story
stories.text:
"My mom and dad are both Espers."
The first time Linko talked about her family, she scared the Bureau's archivist half to death, because they'd already checked—her parents were perfectly normal—or at least, in Hethereau, normal people with no Esper abilities.
But then she further explained that her "Dad's Esper Ability is sitting perfectly still through more than a dozen movies in a row," and her "Mom's Esper Ability is walking more than a dozen street blocks without stopping," causing everyone to let out a sigh of relief. Afterwards, they immediately started gossiping about how such amazing people could've ended up together.
Linko's mother was an urban exploration blogger—an endlessly energetic go-getter who believed in ghosts, urban legends, UFOs, aliens, and just about every other paranormal thing you could think of. Every day she'd trawl forum posts for leads, and the moment she thought, "This might be a real one!" she'd set off to investigate… Of course, most of the time her impulsiveness got her fooled by those half-baked posts and she'd end up empty-handed, but she never let such things discourage her. Eventually, she really did stumble into a legitimate spooky spot… and subsequently fell into an Anomalous Realm. There, she met another unlucky soul: a film nerd obsessed with supernatural movies, stuck in a creative rut, who'd shut himself away for days to research new creative ideas before deciding on that spot to shoot his new project.
And so, a very Hethereau kind of love story began. Two young people whose personalities were complete opposites met in the Anomalous Realm. At first, they couldn't stand each other, but then later helped each other, stayed together, escaped danger alongside each other, kept thinking about each other, and finally, the next time they ran into each other, confessed their feelings. Linko has heard that story from them both many-a-time, along with plenty of conflicting versions—but the one thing that never changed was their continual adoration for each other.
After Linko was born, those two young Hethereau parents poured all their love into her, and thus she inherited their quirks, too. The first time their daughter crawled into the bedroom with a pacifier in her mouth, Dad generously shared one of his treasured finds—his carefully edited, age-appropriate supernatural movies… And just like that, before she had even outgrown her bottle, Linko could watch horror flicks with her father without batting an eye. Not long after she learned to walk, Mom would take her out to practice, only to get distracted by some shop she'd never been to before and somehow end up walking up and down the entire city block… Strange as all that sounds, whenever Linko talks about her mom and dad, she wears the same happy smile they do.
In any case, little Linko grew up bathed in love.

stories.title: The First Connection
stories.text:
Linko's Esper Abilities awakened at the young age of seven.
It was an utterly ordinary evening. Linko's mother had taken her along on a stroll through the supermarket, picking up holiday snacks and decorations while they were out. Linko followed her mother, yet her gaze drifted to a peculiar shop down the street. When she snapped back into reality, her mother had vanished entirely. The crowd was gone too, along with the surrounding noise, leaving her alone in an empty mall. At the time, she was too young to understand what an Anomalous Realm was. Initially, Linko had only wanted to escape that strange maze so that she could find her mother. The space itself was seemingly infinite, however. Linko called out in a faint little voice and cried, with no idea where to go. Hours later, exhausted, she fell to the floor, with almost nothing left but a plea on her lips…
"If only I could find Mom and Dad."
As if answering that wish, all at once, countless loud "voices" surged in from beyond, flooding the empty mall, then spiraling inward like a vortex and forcing their way into her mind: confused, wary, uncertain, worried, lonely, sirens, barking dogs, singing, ragged breathing… and her mother.
Driven by instinct, her young, exhausted body pushed itself back to its feet. Among the countless invisible threads of sounds, she followed the warmest, most familiar one and continued walking.
Farther. Just a little farther.
The "voices" grew louder and louder, and more and more noises poured into her mind. She could no longer think straight. She could only continue to walk—
Linko could barely remember how she escaped. She only knew that when she opened her eyes again, her tearful parents were holding her tight, and the unfamiliar people in uniforms nearby sighed in relief.
Linko later learned that after she was drawn into an Anomalous Realm, the Bureau dispatched the Containment Units to intervene and rescue her. What she didn't know was that as soon as search personnel confirmed the exit, everyone present suddenly felt as if they were hearing an imaginary, chaotic uproar. Electronic communications briefly went down, and some people even claimed they were seeing double, or that they heard the same voice from multiple directions at once. The incident itself severely disrupted the rescue operation. The Bureau had even suspected that an Esper was the cause, and had already prepared to send in ETD for investigation. But then, all of a sudden, Linko stepped out of the Anomalous Realm on her own. The instant she heard her mother calling out to her, she froze, and the noise disturbing everyone else stopped immediately. The Bureau members on site glanced at one another.
"The trapped citizen is safe and rescued. Victim is a suspected Esper. As for the target Anomaly… Nullification confirmed."

stories.title: Friends
stories.text:
At first, Linko desperately sought friends.
The flocks of pigeons at dawn, the comets at midnight, the ducks by the river, the shells on the beach, the interesting little shop her mother found, the new game her father recommended—and all those countless frequencies from the infinite beyond reaching into her little head… Linko wished to speak about it to a true friend.
Despite this, she was always alone. Maybe because of her parents, Linko was more tolerant and curious than other kids her age. Whether it was Anomalies, insects, ghost stories, or urban legends, Linko was always full of curiosity. After her Esper Ability awakened, her ability to sense frequencies made the way she perceived the world around her unlike anyone else. Because of that, she had a very difficult time making friends. Even when she joined after-school group activities, she would just stand quietly in the corner.
"Everyone has their own channel. If I try tuning in to their frequency first… could I become friends with them?"
After her Esper Ability awakened, Linko could receive and discern other people's frequencies. If she spent some time tuning to the same frequency as someone else, she could even begin to experience that person's emotions… Were such a thing to come to pass, as long as she kept paying attention to how they felt, she should slowly but surely figure out what would make them happy. At least, that's what Linko thought.
So, the lonely girl began trying to approach other children her age. She was a little stiff and awkward, but it eventually started to work. At last, though she was merely the quietest little tagalong in the bunch, she had finally found the "friends" she had always wanted.
Anyhow, that was what she believed before the split.

stories.title: Divergence
stories.text:
Humans and Anomalies can't ever truly understand each other's feelings. Or rather, a human can never really understand an Anomaly.
A group of bored children came across a lone Fluffy in the grass. The kid leading the group got a bright idea: he wanted to see what the Fluffy looked like after it transformed, and the others quickly agreed. Treating it like a toy, their poking and teasing gradually transformed into bullying. There is a natural divide between humans and Anomalies; therefore, it is only natural for children not to empathize with an Anomaly. But Linko stood there in silence, unsure how to speak up. Little by little, she began to pick up Fluffy's frequency as it shifted from hurt and confusion into anger.
"St… stop! It's… really sad right now, and if you guys keep going… it'll be dangerous…"
For the first time in her life, Linko shouted at her "friends."
But what came next, whether it was the frequency she felt or the voices she heard, crushed her hopes.
"It's just an Anomaly. Why are you trying so hard to play the saint…?"
"You care so much about what it feels like, but you don't care about how we feel?"
"What a buzzkill freak…"
More than hurt, what filled Linko's heart was disappointment. She and the Fluffy stayed in that grassy field, silent for a long, long time.
Do people boxed in by common sense or prejudice really understand each other? Can they even understand each other at all? Maybe "fitting in" itself is just an illusion; people imprisoned by judgment can never truly understand one another, and all efforts to fit in will only end in a futile tug-of-war.
"We all live in our own frequencies, sending signals into the universe that go unanswered."
That night, Linko wrote in her diary.
Humans can't understand each other either. One person can never really understand how another feels.
Like stars in the night sky, like islands in the sea, gazing at one another across an abyss…
Linko no longer wanted friends.

stories.title: Master Tamachi
stories.text:
When Linko was ten, she would often follow frequencies and wander all over the city by herself. Feeling out unknown frequencies and exploring wherever they led became her own private, joyful way of passing the time—even if her adventures usually only turned up strange little things, and sometimes even led her to dangerous Anomalies, Linko never got tired of it.
One afternoon, Linko sensed a warm, welcoming frequency, full of an energetic, life-filled energy. She followed its direction, passing through streets and alleys, turning several corners, and even climbing a big tree, all under the frequency's guidance.
She was small, however, and the trunk was huge. She ran out of strength halfway up the tree. Stuck there with nowhere to go, she could only curl up and think of a way out of her situation. Suddenly, a girl in a Clement Academy uniform jumped down from a higher branch and helped her down, all while saying things like, "What were you thinking, climbing a tree this high all by yourself?"
"I'm playing Tamachi GO. I thought I could catch a Rare Tamachi up in the tree, but instead… I only caught you! Here, let me show you my Tamachi Index…"
"Huh?! That really is a Rare Tamachi! You must be a genius at this sort of thing!"
A gentle, kind frequency came from the girl. Like a sunflower basking in the sun. Linko brightened up too.
After that, Linko often went exploring all over the city with her newfound sister-figure, and she started collecting her own Tamachi Index too. She always searched for Tamachi purely by instinct. Even though it got her into plenty of trouble from time to time, the joy of pet-hunting outweighed it all. Still, her Index never quite caught up to her sister's.
Two years later, her sister became busy with school and handed her beloved console and handwritten strategy notes over to Linko, asking her to inherit her Tamachi Index and become a Tamachi Master for the both of them.
"Linko is the best guide in all of Hethereau. Believe in yourself—your path is the right path!"
That was what Linko's sister had said to her the last time they met.
After that, Linko kept exploring the city, squeezing into every nook and cranny to catch Tamachi. She still got lost often, but in the end, she always found her way back home. Every time she caught a new Tamachi, she compared her own Index with her sister's, only to find that her sister had already collected it. Nevertheless, Linko didn't lose heart. She just kept searching, believing that one day her Index would catch up to her sister's and even surpass it.
But from then on, every time she caught a Tamachi, Linko never again felt that same warm, lively frequency.
"So the source of that frequency was my sister all along…"

stories.title: Ghostly Encounter
stories.text:
After starting middle school, Linko still often strolled around Hethereau, following the guidance of all kinds of strange frequencies. One day, she went in through the back door of a building and accidentally stumbled into an Anomalous Realm. It was a room with walls that were lined with old TVs, most of them with broken screens that no longer turned on. Following a faint but warm frequency, she searched through the pile of battered old TVs and found one that was very, very small.
Driven by a sudden instinct, Linko pressed the power switch. After a burst of static, a little ghost suddenly popped out.
"Wah!! You unlucky little imp, how dare you disturb this evil spirit's rest! As compensation, starting today, you belong to this evil spirit as its servant! Heh heh heh—mmph—"
Having seen plenty of horror movies, Linko wasn't scared in the slightest. She simply scooped up the little ghost like she was catching a stray cat on any normal day.
"So you were fine, after all. Just a minute ago, your frequency almost disappeared."
"Huh? Frequency? Gone? What kind of nonsense are you spewing? I was just taking a little nap in the TV!"
"You live in a TV… Tamachi live in a screen too, so you're basically like a Tamachi—oh! So you're an electronic pet!"
"Huh? What the hell is that supposed to mean? Who are you calling a pet!? Believe it or not, this evil spirit will mmmph—"
"Yes. From now on, I'll call you Xiaozhen."
After that baffling negotiation, Linko took the little ghost Xiaozhen away… along with her TV.
But when they left the Anomalous Realm, a group of people in Bureau uniforms were already waiting at the entrance for them.
What Linko didn't know at the time was that Xiaozhen had long existed as an Anomaly inside the office building. She could slip into all kinds of TVs and would occasionally pop out to scare employees working late. But on that day, an Esper criminal broke into the building with hopes to cause harm. Just as he was about to attack an innocent employee, they were suddenly dragged into the Anomalous Realm. According to the people who experienced it firsthand, it was a labyrinth made from countless piled-up TVs. They were sealed away in a safe room, while the criminal was confronted by ghostly fire spilling out from countless TV screens, and by a massive ghost formed from those coalescing flames. The battle in the Anomalous Realm lasted for what felt like hours. The ghost's strength was nearly exhausted, and was almost nullified. However, Xiaozhen used the last of her strength to fling the criminal out of the Anomalous Realm. After that, she found the last intact TV and went into a deep slumber… until Linko suddenly woke her again.
In the end, ETD-6 arrested the injured Esper criminal in the empty building. Not long afterward, Linko and the office workers reappeared inside. Fortunately, there were no casualties. Linko and Xiaozhen were investigated by the Bureau following the whole debacle. Linko met a grim-faced young man, and the uniformed personnel seemed to treat him with considerable deference.
"The Celaeno Compound is interested in that ghost."
Linko didn't know what kind of place that was, but her instincts told her it couldn't mean anything good for Xiaozhen. She could vaguely sense that even within the deathly-still frequency of the man before her, there might be a weak point she could utilize…
"Xiaozhen isn't a malicious spirit. I'm not handing her over to you, because…"
Firm and unflinching, Linko clutched the TV with Xiaozhen inside tightly to her chest.
"—she's my friend. I don't want to be separated from her."
"…"
The young man said nothing more. Not long after, Linko received a document. An ETD captain secured the decision that allowed her to keep Xiaozhen. On the condition that she accept ETD oversight and arrangements, she would be permitted to become Xiaozhen's Guarantor.
"Xiaozhen, Xiaozhen! I'm your official Guarantor now!"
"Guarantor? What does that mean?"
"It's not a master and not a servant… um… whatever. The point is, you get to stay with me!"
"…Heh heh heh~ Then this evil spirit shall graciously look after you, little frequency imp!"

title: Eibon Staff

She looks like a delinquent girl who might pull out a baseball bat at any time, yet she often helps old ladies cross the street, rescues cats stuck in trees in the Bridge Crossings, and assists those trapped by Anomalies. To the "most prestigious family head in the Bridge Crossings," these are just random acts. She's still troubled by the Coluccis' revitalization plan.
"Hey, look up! The Coluccis' Ichi-daime is about to make a grand… OUCH!!!"
"Sorry, sorry, sorry, I'll pay for the broken flowerpot… Can the bill not be sent to Eibon?"

profile.occupation: Staff; Ichi-daime of the Colucci Family
profile.intro: The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—currently seeking new recruits!
profile.quote: When dragons meet tigers, I rule my turf! Colucci Family, now recruiting!

stories.text:
Nanally, the queen of Bridge Crossings, whose reputation for causing trouble is known far and wide.
Facing the famous Eibon antique shop, it took Nanally just one glorious month to go from challenging them to being held as collateral for debt.
Work hard, Colucci Family Ichi-daime! Make the world bow and tremble before those mighty fists!

When not on quests, Nanally spends most of her time wandering around trying to revive the Colucci Family.
Her top recruitment targets are obviously the Eibon folks. Sure, there's a dummy or two, but they're pretty decent people overall. Well… they can share in the family's glorious revival.

She's picky about food. Mackerel must be crispy, and lamb chops better come smothered in sauce.
For post-meal cleanup, try Fluffy Tail Care Spray, no ads needed, love from Nanally.
Post-meal exercise options include 360° wall parkour, patrolling territory, or picking a fight with someone. The first one's recommended, safe and risk-free.
Nanally's top pick for best scenic spot in Hethereau is… oh no! A family boss can't reveal her whereabouts!
Though Nanally did mention enjoying some view with an important companion before… but who was it… who was it… she can't remember either. That's what happens when important people forget things, right?

Finally, something important must be said three times:
Nanally is not a cat, she's a tiger! Not a cat, a tiger! Not a tiger, a cat… bah! Not a cat, a tiger!

stories.title: Ichi-daime's Badge
stories.text:
A carefully cut tiger-shaped bottle cap, topaz blue plastic wrap, plus one unbreakable little safety pin.
Anyone who dares to underestimate the badge on Nanally's chest better be ready for a flurry of punches!
Power, power keeps flowing endlessly… Heh heh, feel the bond of the Colucci Family!

stories.title: "Nini's Adventures"
stories.text:
Nanally's favorite gang anime when she was a kid… and of course, it's still her favorite now.
She's especially obsessed with the pink muscle tiger that appears at 12:07 in Episode 3… absolutely unforgettable! That towering figure, standing unwavering amidst the sparks and lightning, mirrors Nanally's lifelong creed.
If only she could befriend it… they'd be an unbeatable team.

stories.title: "Family Quotes Collection"
stories.text:
"Don't worry about my attitude, I'm tough as nails (snorts)." - Nanally
"Fist to flesh, thunder and lightning! This is the romance of gang life (throws punch)!" - Nanally
"Walking this path… it means constant encounters and farewells… I understand that (sighs)…" - Nanally

stories.title: Justice From Above
stories.text:
At age 8, during the "Puka Crispy Stick Snatching Incident," Nanally defeated a greedy kid and helped him quit sweets. He later lost weight and became the school heartthrob.
At age 9, during the "Torchwood Basketball Court Invasion Incident," she drove off three middle school bullies and opened a hole in a third-floor window with a basketball to improve ventilation.
At age 10, during the "Helping Granny Cross the Street Incident," she achieved the impressive record of only taking 5 seconds from one side of the street to the other. Granny's legs even recovered instantly, and she walked away briskly. What a miracle!

stories.title: World Flip
stories.text:
Ever seen a reversed spherical magnetic field?
The office building is like underwear that got flipped upside down, and the trees along the edge are tiger tails all frizzed up from static.
The sun gets stuck to the horizon… shadows overlap with magnetic fields… Welcome to a whole new world that's never been revealed.

name: Sakiri
title: Eibon Staff
desc:
A white-haired girl with the horn of an oni, accompanied by a one-eyed ghost humming a strange nursery rhyme, often causes clients to doubt her due to her height… For your safety, please avoid mentioning this directly to her. Thank you.
"Kiroumaru! Stop eating random things. Spit it out!"
"Sakiri, you stingy little… ouch!"

profile.intro: Unrivaled at Eibon and as scary as she looks.
profile.quote: Everyone better stay away from Kiroumaru! Don't come crying to me when you get your butt bitten.

stories.text:
The main obstacles to Eibon owner Hotori's dreams of getting rich are, aside from the owner's own issues, the unavoidable compensation fees after every commission from the "Eibon Ace Trio (self-proclaimed)," especially for things Sakiri breaks. What Kiroumaru swallows is small stuff, but when Sakiri gets really mad and swings Kiroumaru around, well…
Of course, Sakiri gets a good scolding from Hotori for pulling stunts like that, but judging from Eibon's monthly bills and Adler's furrowed brow, the effect probably isn't great.

Even though Sakiri brings all sorts of trouble to Eibon every time she goes on quests, if you leave her idle in the shop…
One second she's reading "Weekly Fantasy," the next she might grab some scene from the manga and get Nanally to take her out for fun, ahem, building The Coluccis. If she doesn't follow Nanally out to cause trouble, then poor Taygedo gets it instead. And even if Sakiri miraculously stays put in the shop for once, Kiroumaru can still create some accidents…

Trouble seems to follow Sakiri wherever she goes, but unlike Nanally, Sakiri never causes major disasters and can even bail Nanally out when it counts. While it looks like Nanally is the one dragging Sakiri and Edgar around everywhere for The Coluccis, when you really think about it… maybe Sakiri is actually the most reliable one?

Oh, and if you don't want to get hit with Kiroumaru's "Memory Correction Technique," remember this well: don't get curious about the things Sakiri sneakily throws away every day, or else…

stories.title: Colucci Family, Second in Command
stories.text:
Personally certified by the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, the cornerstone of growing bigger, getting stronger, and reaching new heights!
"Sakiri! Edgar! I just thought of a new plan for the family!"
"Seriously? Again? Should we make a run for it while we can?"
"If we don't listen… Nanally's gonna keep going on about it next time…"
"Give me a break…"
"Come on! This'll be the meeting that decides the Coluccis' fate!"

stories.title: Honest Popping Candy
stories.text:
"Hehe, Edgar, what exactly did Sakiri say after she ate that Honest Popping Candy last time? Taygedo said I missed quite a show!"
"Um… Sakiri told me not to say…"
"Oh come on, it's fine, Sakiri's not…"
"Dummy! What are you whispering about with Nanally?! Time to get to work, Kiroumaru!"
"No no no no no no! I don't know anything yet!"

stories.title: Kiroumaru
stories.text:
An Anomaly that seems born just to eat! It eats food, it eats radios, it eats bike wheels, it eats tires, eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat!
"Sakiri, can I eat this? Sakiri, can I eat that?"
Anyway, as long as it can stay by Sakiri's side and eat eat eat, it's happy! Always following Sakiri around, eat eat eat!

stories.title: "With everyone now…"
stories.text:
A melody few have ever heard, Sakiri never hums this nursery rhyme in front of others.
For someone who acts too mature for her age most of the time, this is one of those rare moments when she actually shows her inner child.
Though Sakiri always keeps quiet about it, perhaps we can glimpse something from this song…
From this lonely and eerie nursery rhyme, we might see some hints of her past.

stories.title: "A place that won't abandon me"
stories.text:
At the end of the "Pawn Moonlight" incident, Otro gave Sakiri a gift: a box containing little bears designed to look like Eibon members.
Sometimes Sakiri hides in her room and takes out the bears to play with them, surrounded by the little figures like she's playing house.
Though she's never said it out loud, she really loves this gift.

Kiroumaru opens its mouth to continuously pull targets nearby within a cone. Movable objects in the scene will be destroyed, and weak enemies will be devoured. name: Adler
title: Eibon Butler
desc:
The true pillar of the Eibon Antique Shop is a humble and reliable old-fashioned gentleman. Many Anomaly Hunter organizations in Hethereau have tried to poach him, but Mr. Adler steadfastly remains Eibon's butler.
"Hello, welcome to Eibon Antique Shop."

profile.intro: The perfect butler who brings peace of mind to everyone at Eibon and the neighborhood.
profile.quote: Sincerely accepting commissions for antique appraisal and Anomaly Commissions.

stories.text:
Adler, full name Alois V. Adler. Although no one has ever called this clearly respectable butler by his full name. At Eibon, being a butler is an incredibly difficult job. Daily duties include but are not limited to: preparing seven completely different breakfasts and getting picky kids to eat their vegetables, keeping track of and restocking the store's alcohol and hangover remedy supplies, damage control plans for unavoidable losses during commissions, maintaining a positive attitude when facing the shop's account balance…
All in all, any one is lucky to have a butler like him.

Gold medal swordsman, ten-ring archery certificate, advanced tea ceremony instructor, and Bridge Crossings Paper Plane Competition champion. Hethereau's true certification master, "perfect" is never just talk. Nanally once started a challenge called "What can't the amazing Adler do?" with the winner receiving a "Lifetime Honorary Member" title from the Coluccis. Nanally herself won the competition: "Mr. Adler has definitely never caused trouble!" Though as the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, she probably didn't need that reward. As for whether Adler has ever caused any trouble… one would think not.

"Sorry, old man! I'll definitely watch where I put the flowerpots next time, I won't break the sixty-eighth one!"
"You said the same thing when the sixty-seventh one broke."
"Taygedo (Eibon's flowerpot destruction master).” 
"It's fine, it's just a pot. The roots weren't damaged. We'll just get a new one."
"Then I'll buy the new pot with my allowance!"
During the days when he first fell into darkness, Adler once accidentally broke a flowerpot too, one worth one year, four months, and thirteen days of "allowance." Thanks to that, Adler has never accidentally broken anything since.

"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.

stories.title: An Old Story
stories.text: As the most frequently appearing Sunya, Rupa has its own special nickname at Eibon: "Little Thing." It's the fifth provisional member of The Coluccis, following Taygedo, Edgar, and Sakiri. Although Little Thing doesn't understand what this means, it still loves the name. Whether it's preparing meals or cleaning up, Little Thing is Mr. Adler's best helper. As for payment for its help… just pat its head and reward it with a slice of carrot cake.

stories.title: Sunya - Rupa
stories.text: If you had to name the Sunya closest to Eibon, it would definitely be Vedana. Vedana is a sucker for tragic manga endings, a great teammate for co-op games, and the perfect partner for scarfing down midnight snacks. Compared to other Sunyas, Vedana seems to have particularly rich emotions, but actually, Sunyas don't have distinct feelings. Vedana is just good at sensing others' emotions and mimicking them. There was a time when Vedana was quite puzzled by this. Feeling joy because of others' happiness, feeling pain because of others' suffering… where did its own emotions come from? It asked this question to Enlightenment's master. Vedana can't remember how Adler answered anymore, but it remembers that the carrot cake that day was delicious, and that feeling of joy came from itself alone.

stories.title: Sunya - Vedana
stories.text:
Most days at Eibon are pretty peaceful. Adler doesn't force the Sunyas to do anything. So on days without commissions, they have their own hobbies. Sanna loves to paint. Whenever Eibon receives antique paintings, Sanna is always the first to step forward, identifying authenticity and handling storage. One day, Adler gave Sanna a set of art supplies. From that day on, Sanna became Bagel's newest artist. They say that just one look at Sanna's paintings would make you hear sounds, smell scents, and taste flavors. Unfortunately, no Collection Hall has ever been able to own or even display one of Sanna's works.
Sanna gave its very first painting to Adler, even though it was just a piece of paper with a few hoof prints on it, imprinted like falling snow.

stories.title: Sunya - Sanna
stories.text:
Sankhara is the second Sunya to appear in "Enlightenment," and was born from the karma created by war and conflict. Each generation of Enlightenment's masters always had desires, and the fires of karma burned the armor scales day and night. The Sunya gradually fell into slumber, while Sankhara became increasingly awake, since this was the very meaning of its birth. Until the chaotic times passed and this armor became a symbol, eventually forgotten in a dim storage room. Sometimes servants or guests would pause before Enlightenment, speaking their desires to it, but after drinking such burning hatred, most wishes born in peaceful times seemed boring. Enlightenment remained silent. Sankhara sometimes wondered if it too should sleep like its "siblings."
Fortunately, Sankhara really liked snowy days, and fortunately, just as Sankhara was preparing to enjoy one last snowfall before sleeping, it heard a wish, one far more greedy than owning an entire city: "I have so many, many things I want to protect."
In any case, Enlightenment responded to that blind child, and Sankhara had no choice but to follow this new master's way of thinking. Now Sankhara's daily work is taking care of children and using its amazing speed to snag the day's discount items.

stories.title: Sunya - Sankhara
stories.text:
Vinnana rarely appears before outsiders. Most of the time, it sleeps lazily inside Enlightenment. After all, it was the first Sunya to appear by Mr. Adler's side. "This old one doesn't have that much energy anymore," it always says. Whether it's truly tired from the passage of time or for some other unknown reason, only Vinnana itself knows. However, when it comes to talking about Adler, Vinnana is quite willing to say a few more words.
"Alois, ah… Just to see me, that child would sleep in the corridor every day without saying a word. It was this old one's kind heart, who couldn't bear to see a child suffer, that reluctantly responded to him. Who knew that child would later…"
What follows is Vinnana rambling on about hardships over the years, and those are about what it'd speak of Adler.

name: Aurelia
title: Shop Street Manager
desc:
The moment her phone battery hit zero, the map on the screen went completely dark.
During those busy periods when work consumes everything, this can happen occasionally.
Half an hour later, Aurelia paused at a familiar-looking intersection: "Didn’t I just pass that shop?"
No matter how lost she feels, her optimism has always been her greatest strength.
No matter the challenge, she refuses to give up hope—the path forward is hers to choose and forge.
Riding her jellyfish, Aurelia resolutely sets off again, even if it's in the wrong direction.

profile.intro: A fun fact about Hethereau, thanks to meeting Aurelia: cruising the streets on a jellyfish isn't a traffic violation.
profile.quote: Prime shop locations are available for long-term leases on Tamamochi Street! Interested? Contact me on Bagel Business!
profile.impression:
Once her phone battery reached zero, the music she was listening to abruptly stopped, and her screen went dark. During Tamamochi Street's peak business season—those days where work will completely drain you of life—this kind of thing was a common occurrence.
A half hour later, Aurelia found herself at a familiar intersection, confused and dazed. "That shop… didn't I pass it already?" She murmured.
Regardless of her confusion, Aurelia's sunny demeanor and optimism kept her going.
Aboard her jellyfish, Aurelia squared her shoulders and continued… in the wrong direction.
profile.food: Anything related to the ocean, biology, music, and cute pastries

stories.text:
Aurelia's life has been anything but boring: she sang in a choir, started a band, worked as an Anomaly Hunter, and now she's a diligent salarywoman. With a resume that impressive, some might consider her life a bit too "maxed out" for someone her age—at least, that's what the regulars on Tamamochi Street often gossip to each other. 

Of course, her colorful background never prevented her from diving headfirst into whatever job she takes on. These days, as the street manager of Tamamochi Street, Aurelia can easily name every resident and recall their likes and dislikes—no matter how old or young. She's always the first to offer a helping hand to solve whatever daily problems the residents run into. Her dedication to her job often makes people wonder: just how much does the City Hall pay her? 

After work, Aurelia will sometimes be spotted wandering the streets alone. If you were to walk up and talk to her, nine times out of ten you'll find she's completely lost (and she'll be very grateful to any good samaritan that'd point her in the right direction)… Sometimes, though, Aurelia will pretend to know where she's going, though no one truly believes her. In the end, everyone on Tamamochi Street is Aurelia's friend. However, it seems that there isn't anyone who genuinely understands her.

As for the places she wishes to go but, for some reason or another, can't, and the words she wants to say but swallows them down every time… maybe only someone who stays by her side for a long, long time will ever be allowed to know. Then again, everyone keeps a few secrets locked away in their heart, right? Today, Aurelia is once again smiling, her head held high as she rides her beloved jellyfish down the street, cheerfully greeting everyone she meets. This is the life she chose, no matter what.

stories.title: The Song No One Remembers
stories.text:
Aurelia was born into a stable, happy family. Her parents loved each other very much, and the household was often peaceful. She was the little sweetheart her parents had prayed and prayed for. Their gentle, lovely little plum blossom. The only flaw in this picture-perfect family was… her parents' work schedule. As she grew older, both of her parents advanced their careers. The time they could spend with Aurelia grew less and less. Aurelia understood that her parents were working incredibly hard to give her a better life, so she knew not to throw tantrums or act overly spoiled.
But, now and again, when she saw kids her age walking down the street hand in hand with their parents, Aurelia couldn't help but stare. She knew the thing weighing her down was a "First World Problem"—she never had to worry about her next meal or a new pair of shoes. She got any toy she wanted right away, and even if she was picky about her food or stayed up too late, she never got punished. Wasn't that enough? Compared to her classmates whose parents were strict or distant, she already had so much. She shouldn't be greedy for more.
So, she'd only stare for a moment before looking away quickly and obediently heading toward her empty home. At an age when she didn't fully understand the meaning of "lonely," Aurelia had already seemed to experience "loneliness." 

She got used to not expecting her parents to be around. However, on her birthday, she couldn't help but hope it might be different. Colorful presents, a huge teddy bear, and a triple-tier birthday cake kept her company while she waited. She continued waiting as the sun went down, the sky turning from blue to pink to violet. Soon enough, the moon climbed high into the sky, and the hands of the clock continued to tick inch by inch.
Eventually, Aurelia gave up. She lit the candle that was nearly sinking into the buttercream, sang "Happy Birthday" to herself, and then gently blew it out. For an instant, the room flared with a brilliant, bright glow before slipping back into darkness.
It seems that, even if you make a wish, nothing guarantees it coming true.
"Just once would be enough," She thought. I wish Mom and Dad could come home.

stories.title: The First Melody
stories.text:
Aurelia became friends with Akane and Suzuha on a springtime school trip. She was totally entranced by the jellyfish at the aquarium and, before she knew it, drifted away from the rest of her class's group. Just when she began to panic because she couldn't find a familiar face in the crowd, Akane and Suzuha spotted her. Each of them took one of her hands and led her back to the class rendezvous point, then sat on either side of her on the bus ride home.
From that embarrassing moment onwards, Akane and Suzuha became Aurelia's best friends. 

On the birthday that followed, Aurelia's living room wasn't empty anymore. In front of the incredible gift pile, two girls who'd never seen anything like it merely stared, wide-eyed. "What are you two doing, hiding over there?" The moment they heard Aurelia's voice, Akane immediately tried to shove the tiny present in her hands behind her back. But Aurelia, sharp-eyed as ever, caught her in the act.
"Is that for me? It has to be for me, right?!" Aurelia darted over, making an effort to grab the little box.
"You already have so many presents! T-this one really isn't anything special…"
"That doesn't matter!" Aurelia shouted, full of indignation. She finally managed to get a hold of the gift, hugging it to her chest. "This is my first-ever birthday present from a friend. It's mine, no takebacks!"
"Really… it's nothing…" Akane's voice grew quiet. 
Before she could finish, Aurelia had already ripped the wrapping paper to shreds. Out of the palm-sized box rolled out a few shiny little pins: souvenirs from that same aquarium where they'd first met. The tiny jellyfish mascot wore a cutesy, pitiful expression that, funnily enough, looked like Aurelia when she couldn't stop crying that day. 
Aurelia stared, unblinking, at the pins that had rolled onto the table. Beside her, Akane was so embarrassed she couldn't bear to stay a second longer. She grabbed Suzuha's hand and began to make a move for the door—but before they could even take a step, Aurelia barreled into both of them and wrapped them in a tight hug. The little crybaby was sobbing like the mascot on that pin again. "T-this is perfect… the best thing in the entire world!" She could barely get the words out between her tears.

Even though her parents still couldn't be there for that birthday in particular, Aurelia no longer felt lonely. Suzuha lit the cake candles for her, and Akane set a party hat on her head. The birthday song they sang for her became the most beautiful melody Aurelia had ever heard.
When she blew out the candles, she prayed with all her might that she'd be with these friends of hers forever.

stories.title: First Discordant Note
stories.text:
Aurelia's Esper ability awakened when she was fourteen. She couldn't remember exactly what was going on at the time, except that one time, when she was writing in class, her pen ran out of ink. Just as she gave her pen a shake, an entire school of jellyfish suddenly appeared. Both the teachers and students lost their trains of thought completely upon seeing this, their eyes wide and jaws to the floor. 
In the middle of the crowd, Aurelia was the most confused of all. "I just… did this?"
She tried shaking her hand again. The jellyfish mimicked her hand movements perfectly. Her classmates shouted in excitement, "Aurelia! Are you, like… did you just become…"
"You're an Esper!"

After many tests, it was officially confirmed that Aurelia was indeed an Esper now. But, aside from registering her status at the Bureau of Anomaly Control, her life didn't seem to change at all—until she realized the price she had to pay for it.
Losing her sense of direction turned Aurelia into a stranger in her own hometown. Though she walked the same route to and from school every day, she would forget where she was at any point again and again. The shops along the road all looked familiar, but when it came time to cross the street or turn a corner, her mind drew a complete blank. From then on, no matter where she had to go, Aurelia had to look up the route in advance and memorize every detail. 
Initially, everyone at her school thought Espers were super powerful and cool. They looked at Aurelia with envy and awe. But it turned out that Aurelia's Esper ability was pretty underwhelming. What situation would ever occur where someone needed to summon and control jellyfish? It was entirely useless. It didn't take long for their excitement about her being an Esper to die down, and instead, focus on her daily navigation disasters. Even though the classmates who knew about her condition did their best to look out for her on campus, the moment a shop changed its sign or some road got closed down for construction, Aurelia would end up scrambling around, asking anyone and everyone for directions. In the end, Akane and Suzuha got into the habit of going out of their way to pick Aurelia up and drop her off every day, terrified of her wandering around in the streets in the middle of the night. 
"I don't want to keep bothering you with stuff like this…" Aurelia muttered, her head hanging low. Suzuha held Aurelia's hand, giving it a little tug, signaling that they needed to turn left at the intersection. Walking alongside them, Akane let out a sigh. She lifted her hand and flicked Aurelia on the forehead. Aurelia shrank back, exclaiming, "Ow! That hurt, you know!"
"You became an Esper, that's all. You haven't changed as a person. You've always been a hassle, even since you were little!"
Suzuha burst out laughing next to them. Aurelia puffed out her cheeks in protest, "Akane! You're so mean…"
"Am I wrong? H-Hey! Stay back!"

Warmed by her friends' laughter, Aurelia let the topic go. However, though she stayed sunny and optimistic on the surface, a tiny bit of unease had gripped her heart.
Am I truly the same as before? Can things really stay the same between us?

stories.title: Though We Part, the Song Endures
stories.text:
Aurelia's chances of recovering the use of her legs were slim, but the doctor gently suggested that it wasn't entirely impossible. If more advanced medical technology emerged in the future, or if she encountered an Esper with profound healing powers…. Regardless, the possibility wasn't zero. 
During the breaks in her rehab, she often opened Bagel and stared at the little group chat with her, Akane, and Suzuha. Neither of them had sent a message to the other in a long, long time. Many times, Aurelia had typed out a message, only to delete it. What was she supposed to say to them?
After countless bouts of agonizing over her phone, Aurelia made up her mind: once she recovered a bit more, to the point where she could be discharged from the hospital and take care of herself, she would go see her friends in person and surprise them. She had endless amounts of things she wanted to tell them about. 

However, even after some time had passed, there was still no improvement in her legs. She had learned to stop treating "recovery" as her only hope. Still, with the help of her Esper Ability, her life gradually returned to some semblance of normalcy. Though she couldn't play the drums like before, Aurelia thought nothing of it. With just a bit more effort, the day of her reunion with Akane and Suzuha wouldn't be far off.
Suddenly, her phone buzzed with a special tone—the one she had set for Akane's messages specifically. Aurelia rushed to grab her phone, nearly fumbling it out of her hands in the process. But, the words that met her eyes once she opened the chat window were ones she never could have imagined: "Suzuha is leaving. By the time she messaged me, her car had already driven off…"
…Huh? 
For a moment, Aurelia couldn't comprehend the meaning of those words, as if they were nothing more than a string of meaningless symbols. What did Akane mean by "leaving"? Why would she say that? Her fingers trembled so much she could barely type out a reply, and a flood of questions sat heavy on the tip of her tongue. 
"Where's Suzuha going?"
She was going somewhere without them. Suzuha wouldn't be staying with them anymore. Aurelia… understood. Suzuha was a sensitive and thoughtful girl. If she kept living in Hethereau, a city filled with memories of their friendship, she would only tear open closed wounds. Aurelia knew this, so there was no need to ask. 
"What about LINES?"
She, deep down, knew the answer to that, too. Even if Suzuha stayed, without Aurelia as their drummer, the band would only have two paths going forward: going on a hiatus or disbanding. Of course, she could recommend something like "find a new drummer," but she couldn't bring herself to say that. "LINES" was born from Aurelia's selfish wish, and it existed for the three of them. If one of them left, what meaning was there in the empty shell left behind? 
"What about you?"

Even through her shaking fingers, she typed out those three words. 
In the chat window, the "someone is typing…" bubble flickered for a long, long time. Akane, who always spoke her mind, must have been desperately searching for words to say, just like Aurelia had done prior. Akane, so straightforward and outspoken, had been pushed beyond her limits.
If it weren't for the fact that Aurelia feared being looked down upon or abandoned, if it weren't for her lack of courage… If it weren't for her…
It felt as though thousands of years had passed before a new message had finally appeared on the screen: "I don't know. I'm sorry."
Aurelia felt herself begin to tremble. The words before her dissolved like paint in water. 
Why? 
Don't disband. 
Weren't we supposed to be together forever? 
Akane loves singing so much—she should always be on stage. 
There was so much Aurelia wanted to say, but she no longer felt she had the right to say it. The one who brought "LINES" to an end, the one who forced Suzuha to leave her hometown, the one who made it so Akane could never sing again… it wasn't fate. It was herself. 
And yet, even so, there was still one thing she wanted to convey. Even if the damage had already been done, even if it was far too late… 

"I love your music, Akane. Please, even if you feel like stopping now, continue it in the future."
"I promise you, I'll definitely be waiting for you wherever you go."

stories.title: Echoes of the Past
stories.text:
Away from the stage and all kinds of Anomaly Commissions, Aurelia found herself with nothing much to do. The thread that had always pulled her forward suddenly snapped. Aurelia had lost her direction all at once. 
She used to think about the future: "LINES" would become the band best at dealing with anomalies and the best at playing music among anomaly hunter organizations… They would leave Hethereau, go on tour, and become legends! When it came to the imagination, there was no such thing as a "limit." But now, nothing seemed to matter anymore.
To pass the boredom of being in the hospital, Aurelia started helping a busy elderly woman in the same ward as her with paperwork. Before being discharged, the old woman extended an invitation: "how about continuing to help out at my business?"
…That didn't seem like a bad idea. It wasn't like she had anywhere else to go anyway.

As if bidding farewell to everything she knew, Aurelia began a brand new life on Tamamochi Street. Not far from StarSign, she became an ordinary part-time office worker.
The street itself was lively, with people constantly coming and going. She knew she had once been a member of the band "LINES," but most residents knew absolutely nothing about her. For the current Aurelia, none of that mattered much anymore. Adults appreciated her professionalism, whereas children thought her riding around on jellyfish was the coolest thing in the world. Before she knew it, she had become "Little" or "Big Sister" Aurelia.
Only once in a while did she muster the courage to take a detour after work and visit StarSign. But, when she reached the steps she had once bounced down endlessly with excitement, she realized: her jellyfish was too big to squeeze down that long, narrow staircase.
The door to the past had permanently closed on her, and she could never go back. The words left unsaid, and tears left unshed, were all that remained in her heart.
She absolutely wished to see Akane and Suzuha again. To hear Akane's song, and see Suzuha's smile—yet she felt that if she ever uttered such a thing out loud, that tiny wish would warp into some kind of curse.
At the very least, she would allow herself to go to every "Night of Moondog"—an Anomalous Realm vast enough to hold all the songs and dreams in the world, or at least one big enough to accommodate one jellyfish. She scanned the list of songs each time she visited, searching for familiar names, only to be disappointed again and again. But, no matter what, Aurelia believed that someday, that little girl born for music would return.

stories.text:
Of the "Eibon Anomaly Detectives," most say he looks the most befitting of the 'detective' mantle. Edgar neither denies nor confirms this… Probably because explaining it would be really, really troublesome.
After all, his other titles include "Eibon Ace Trio," "Hyelp's Most Promising Rising Star," "Bridge Crossings' Top 3 Anomaly Hunter," and countless other impressive-sounding nicknames that Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo (and sometimes Kiroumaru too) casually make up.

Despite still being a baby-faced boy, he's remarkably mature for his age; almost old-fashioned, likely because the other two are so impulsive that Edgar is always the one left bowing and thanking people. More often than not, he's the one apologizing and paying the bills.
Of course, Edgar's main responsibilities are gathering intel and planning operations. As for how many times those plans have been followed… well, as long as the results are good, who cares? Edgar has come to fully embrace this philosophy; though it doesn't stop him from carefully preparing each time and having a Plan B ready for any unexpected situations that might (or rather, definitely will) occur.
Taygedo often watches the three young Hunters head out and sighs with mock profundity: "Future Edgar will be just like Adler!"

stories.title: Like mother, like son.
stories.text:
They say forgetting is part of growing up. Most adults only retain hazy fragments of their childhood memories, as if viewing them through some kind of fuzzy filter that makes everything impossible to see clearly.

Edgar is different. With enough effort, he can recall every single day with perfect clarity.

The day Edgar’s family discovered his esper ability went like this:

Edgar was three years old. It was an ordinary evening, no different from any other. His parents had just come home from work, and they were enjoying family time around the dinner table. Light, delicious dishes accompanied by Dad's interesting little anomaly stories made for the perfect cozy atmosphere.

Both of Edgar's parents were clerks at Yggash Court. They were responsible for writing and maintaining anomaly profiles, so Dad always had endless stories to tell. The stories were little tales adapted from the publicly available anomaly profiles he wrote during work hours.

But young Edgar didn't know any of this yet. Whenever Dad got carried away telling stories at the dinner table, he'd look down to see his precious son's bright, sparkling eyes gazing up at him…

Being worshipped by his son as the "Story King" made all those overtime hours worth it.

"That's strange? It seems different from what Dad wrote in the files? Which one is actually true?"

Something changed forever the moment Edgar asked this serious question. Edgar's dad would probably remember that instant for the rest of his life. But his dad quickly focused on something more crucial: how did Edgar know about the anomaly profiles he'd just filed?

Had his son snuck out through the window and run all the way to Yggash Court to read the files? Did such a small child even have clearance to access those documents?

Over the next half hour, Mom and Dad finally figured out what was happening: Edgar only needed to focus his imagination (both adults also had to stretch their own imaginations to picture this) to connect with various libraries around the world, including Yggash Court's archive. Edgar had probably been too curious about what Dad had written, and couldn't help thinking about his father's name… One by one, the anomaly profiles bearing Edgar's father's signature unfolded in Edgar's mind…

By the way, Edgar had discovered this ability long ago. It was probably innate, right? It's just that earlier on, he couldn't read very well, so he couldn't understand all those dense markings on the white papers…

Edgar had probably already read through his father's early work files, when his writing style was still immature. His dad’s "dark history" was now completely exposed to his son. With this realization, Edgar's dad decided to escape to the kitchen to wash dishes, planning to study his son's esper ability more carefully later.

"This child really takes after me. On the night of our first date, I also read through all your papers from cover to cover."

His wife wouldn’t let him off the hook either.

stories.title: What does Edgar want to be?
stories.text:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Twinkle School of Espers, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."

stories.title: The World Beyond the Tree Hollow
stories.text:
- Point One: Edgar really likes Anomalies
- Point Two: Edgar's mind is reasonably sharp
- Point Three: Edgar can easily access Anomaly profiles

Therefore, Edgar is well-suited to work at Yggash Court's archives like his parents, organizing documents and studying Anomaly-related topics until the day he dies.

Edgar's mother had to work very hard to suppress her laughter at her son's reasoning; not because the conclusion was absurd or ridiculous—quite the opposite, actually. The logic was clear and the reasoning sound, leaving almost no room for refusal.
But having Edgar move into Yggash Court's tree hollow, put on thick beer-bottle glasses, and bury himself in stacks of files was still a bit… premature. Mom understood her son's wishes, but… Wouldn't it be better for Edgar to personally verify those details, rather than learning about Anomalies from other people's reports? Who knew what Anomalies might be waiting around the next corner? How many unknown Anomaly characteristics were still waiting for us to discover them?
Edgar listened very seriously.

He'd probably inherited his mother's adventurous spirit too. What seemed like a rather silly promise was sealed with a pinky promise. Mom took Edgar's hand and, blindfolded, threw a dart at a map. Luck—or perhaps fate—decided Edgar's adventure: his first journey after graduation would take him to Hethereau.

Forever curious, forever seeking knowledge, forever willing to try.

stories.title: The Fateful Job Posting
stories.text:
Standing on the bustling street corner, Edgar had no idea where he was supposed to go. Though he thought for a long, long time, he remained just as lost, just as confused.
He gave up on route planning, maps, and navigation. Following his mother's advice, he was now "letting the wind guide him" through Hethereau. According to her, encounters with destiny often arrive when you least expect them.
With no destination and no clue which direction to take, could he really find his "destiny" this way? Edgar couldn't fathom such an unplanned approach; the indecision paralyzed him. Instead, he bought a small bag of feed from a street vendor and crouched by the fountain to feed the pigeons.

Later, when Edgar looked back on that day, he felt he'd begun to dimly understand what his mother meant by "fate."
As he felt the pigeons pecking at his palm, watching the sky gradually turn a warm orange as golden clouds drifted toward the still-blue horizon, a sudden gust of wind smacked him right in the face. Along with it came a recruitment poster with crooked handwriting and a drawing of some TV-headed creature.

"Eibon Antique Shop."
He stood up, looked around, and followed the street signs to Hankaku Street.

stories.title: Hearts Will Find Their Way
stories.text:
They didn't share a language, but understanding Taygedo wasn't too difficult.
By combining the tone and frequency of Taygedo's "Tayge-tayge" sounds with his expressions and gestures, Edgar deciphered:
"Welcome, new friend!"

He began a new chapter in his Anomaly observation diary; it naturally featured the wonderful TV-headed otter. Of course, Edgar's observation records weren't as formal as his parents'; he simply wrote down Taygedo's little habits, quirks, goals… and the many everyday activities with him.
Still, this neat and tidy notebook ran out of space way sooner than Edgar had expected. An entire page was quickly covered with Taygedo's selfies, complete with a bonus paw print. One page had angry highlighter annotations: "So it WAS you, Taygedo! I knew you stole my pudding!" And several consecutive pages had suspicious water stains (best not to think too hard about what liquid that might be), right after the entry: "Should I write about Kiroumaru too? I already agreed on his behalf."

Admittedly, Edgar wasn't very good at expressing himself, but understanding each other didn't necessarily require words, Edgar realized as he lay on the rooftop while stargazing with Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo.

…Though language could speed up the process, Edgar added, after ages spent gesturing with Taygedo—that always ended in confusion.

desc:
Flowing water has no form, drifting wind leaves no trace, and no detail of an Anomaly Commission should ever be overlooked. She looks like an ordinary high school girl, but in reality, she's an elite courier who traverses the shadows… and is the record holder for fastest delivery at Sterry Express.
"My name's Haniel! Hethereau’s goddess of headsets… Hehe, just call me whenever you need me!"

profile.intro: My dream is to become a beautiful high school girl who saves the world!
profile.quote: genesectparanormaldeptace

stories.text:
Haniel. Public Bagel Account: @Haniel_SterryExpress. Private Account: @genesectparanormaldeptace. Current main alt: @fancontentmaster. The public account is for plugging Sterry Express and managing the brand image of Sterry Express—"If the money's good, we deliver anything!" (Jiuyuan's words). The private account is Haniel's main social hub: fics, art, music, cosplay sets… In the scene, she's a god-tier creator with an endless output. Her only flaw? Her posting schedule is a disaster! Her fans live in permanent agony, screaming: "It's so good, I'll take whatever crumbs I can get!" As for the alt, on days she's too lazy to post, Haniel just surfs Bagel incognito on various throwaway accounts. The second her cover is blown, she jumps ship to the next. She's sworn to defend the sacred right to consume fan content in peace.

Ever delivered a package before? Every Sterry Express courier has their own delivery ritual. For Haniel, the moment she gets the delivery slip, it's like a quest notification has dropped straight into her hands——
Today's Quest: Deliver Package (0/1)
Package Integrity: 100%
Time Left: 00:59:59
3-Star Rating:
No-Damage Delivery (0/1)
On-Time Delivery (0/1)
Service with a Smile (0/1)

When Haniel was little, she had a ton of so-called "hobbies": violin, horseback riding, chess… Just like every other kid in her circle, she went through the usual "elite education" routine. She didn't hate any of it, but that didn't mean she liked it either. It all felt like a drizzly, soggy day where the world's colors are washed out and even birds feathers get stuck together.
Haniel likes sunny days better. So, before her nightly bedtime story, little Haniel sat down with her mother for a real conversation on equal footing. She laid out what she wanted and what confused her, asking the person closest to her for help. Her mom gently stroked her hair and apologized, saying she'd failed to notice Haniel's feelings in time.
Finding your true "hobby," the thing that's really yours, is hard. Luckily, Haniel was one of the fortunate ones.

stories.title: "Gen Z" Anniversary Edition Headset
stories.text:
The path to becoming an Elite Courier isn't always smooth sailing.
During her 16th delivery quest, Haniel accidentally lost a package. Even though it was found three hours later and Owner Jiuyuan didn't blame her for anything, Haniel still felt really guilty. Not wanting to worry her family too much, Haniel acted normal at the dinner table, casually chatting about all sorts of topics she was interested in. Of course, brave Haniel wouldn't let negative feelings bother her for long. After a good night's sleep, she was back to her usual self… but before leaving the house, Haniel received a gift. The headset she had mentioned at dinner the night before was now sitting quietly by her bedroom door.
"Haniel will definitely become the best courier ever," read the note on the gift box.

stories.title: Old Journal
stories.text:
Yellowed stickers and childish handwriting… this is the secret Haniel has hidden in the deepest part of her bookshelf.
"The royal hounds are nothing but my steeds. In ten minutes, your crimes will be exposed!"
"Only those who risk everything for victory have the right to stand on the battlefield!"
"You bastards without hope or dreams, I'll keep my back straight and live on until my body is destroyed!"
"The destination doesn't matter at all, as long as I keep moving forward, as long as I don't stop…"
"My revenge… this is where the curtain truly rises."
After all, who doesn't have a notebook stuffed full of childhood memories?

stories.title: Custom Guitar Pick
stories.text:
After finishing binge-watching "Notes of the Future" at 3:43 AM, Haniel ordered a guitar while her eyes were still red from crying. This time, she would rewrite the band's ending herself.
Unfortunately, her elite education included violin, viola, and cello, but she had never been taught how to play guitar. None of that mattered though. Brave Haniel wasn't afraid of any challenge!
Picture this: After school, Haniel rides her bike alone to the park at sunset, a gentle breeze brushing the loose strands by her temples. By the fountain, the sentimental, shy girl finally finds a quiet corner where no one will notice. She takes a deep breath and pulls out a guitar she got from her father, the pick gently caressing the strings as beautiful melodies flow from the girl's fingertips. Leaves fall onto the water's surface, and when the performance ends, another girl jumps out from the nearby bushes with stars in her eyes, saying "Would you like to start a band with me?"
So Haniel sat in the park with her guitar for three whole months, with only cats as her audience… though cat audiences are pretty good too.

stories.title: Sticky Note with Chili Oil Stains
stories.text:
How to Brew the Perfect Cup of Black Tea:
Materials needed: Tea leaves (select OP-grade loose leaf, not tea bags), soft water (no mineral water), fresh pasteurized milk, a bit of white sugar, and an elegant tea set.
Steps: 1. Boil water, bring the soft water to a boil
2. Warm the pot for one minute
3. Ration the tea leaves (one teaspoon of tea leaves per cup)
4. Steep the tea leaves for three minutes
5. It's best to drink tea from ceramic cups
6. Add the milk to the cup first, then slowly pour in the tea
7. Add sugar according to personal preference
8. The best drinking temperature is between 60–65 degrees Celsius
### Remember: Milk first, then tea
A line of messy handwriting: Tea first then milk tastes good too

stories.title: Paw Bookmark
stories.text:
Haniel's books are always filled with bookmarks, each stamped with little animal paw prints. Whenever Haniel befriends small animals in the park, she makes a special bookmark for them, stamping their paws as keepsakes. These little travelers are always on the move. Who knows when they'll meet again?
There's always one slightly worn bookmark in Haniel's books. It’s stamped with a black, somewhat incomplete kitten paw print, and the markings match the black and white bookmark. Haniel never became friends with this one… the cat was far too cautious. While the other cats happily shared the snacks Haniel brought, this one would always watch quietly from a distance.
It still sleeps peacefully on the same little hillside. Haniel sometimes goes there to play guitar, even though she sounds terrible.

title: Member of CSU-2
desc:
Mint believes everyone has a unique scent and prefers to call people by the scent she detects rather than their names. Her quirky nicknames, energetic personality, and top-notch performance in containment work earn her praise from even the strictest seniors. However—
"Hehe, I'm going to become a CSU Ace… Did I fail the containment regulation exam again…? Uwaa…"
Clearly, Mint needs a bit more luck to achieve her dreams.

profile.intro: If there was such a ranking in the Containment Units, I'd probably hold the record for "Most Times Tricked by Anomalies"…
profile.quote: Never failed a course!

stories.text:
My dream is to become a CSU Ace! Player Mint, ready to go!
She probably loves field work the most among all the Containment Units members. She even loves it on scorching hot days. She can sneak a Blizzi Ice Cream during downtime, and won’t hesitate to apply for heat allowance when she gets back to the bureau.
The frequency of Mint's makeup exams at the bureau perfectly matches her field mission frequency.

Loyal user of Fluffy Tail Care Spray, she’s brave enough to try all the new scents. By try, she means sniffing them… Mint would never lick her own tail fur!
Her friendship with Nanally started when both their hands reached for the last bottle of care spray in the store! The partners at Nanally's Eibon Antique Shop are all so nice! Hotori Senpai… definitely has some stories to tell!

Ehhhhh! Found Lacrimosa Senpai again during field work! At times like this, I should definitely contact our reliable Lieutenant… User currently unavailable? Must be in a meeting. I'm doomed! Mint can't handle either Baicang Senpai or Fadia Senpai!

Ha! Another day working hard toward becoming a CSU Ace! Once I get this anomaly into Temporary Containment, I can probably clock out, right?

Sniff sniff, Lavender is here! And that unfamiliar but warm Coco scent next to her is…

stories.title: Colucci Family, Honorary Member
stories.text:
Mint is actually a member of the great Colucci family too… well, to be exact, an honorary member.
After receiving Nanally Colucci's olive branch, Mint thought long and hard about joining, with the same seriousness she puts into preparing for makeup exams.
First! Mint totally respects this genius girl!
Second! A family sounds really cool! Mint loves hanging out with friends (family-members-to-be)!
Most importantly: Mint is worst at saying no to people!
However, Mint ultimately declined Nanally's proposal, promising that as an honorary member of the family, she'd drop by Eibon from time to time.
Because… Containment Units work is super, super busy, and if Nanally suddenly called a family meeting, Mint couldn't guarantee she'd be able to rush over right away. That would make Mint a tardy family member, and she'd be breaking the family rules!
The most important thing about a family is the rules. That's just how it is.

stories.title: Kittens always grow up so fast
stories.text:
There is an inevitable pain that comes with becoming a teenager—its the most unforgettable memory of a child. Waking up in the middle of the night from an ache, growing taller with each stretch of the body…
But for Mint, this physical pain was never present.
Maybe she was too young when her growth spurts hit; she reached her current height before she was 10. Maybe her naturally carefree nature made her unusually slow to react to the changes that come with growing up. Whatever anguish that summer’s on-and-off joint pain might have brought got left behind along with her brand new, unopened summer homework.

stories.title: Tiny and Big Kid
stories.text:
An awkward age, an awkward height. She towered so much over her peers that strangers would mistake her for a high school student several years older. It wasn't too surprising that Mint, as such a "big kid," couldn't really play with her little friends.
Mint liked climbing trees to nap in the sun, a blade of grass between her teeth as she secretly watched the neighbor kids play and fight. Then, casually… or at least trying to make it look casual, she'd help get their kites unstuck from the branches.
"Tiny" suddenly appeared during one of her half-asleep moments, and Mint still remembers how embarrassing she looked tumbling out of that tree.
The young-faced little guy called out to her: "Hey, kid."

stories.title: Kitty Crossbody Bag
stories.text:
A candy-colored waist bag gifted by "Tiny," with a matching notebook inside. The pages are clean, smooth, and absolutely beautiful.
Hands in pockets, super cool "Tiny" gave Mint the childish, adorable gift before parting, stubbornly defending it as "perfect for a little brat like you."
She met someone who looked like a kid, but was actually a sharp-eyed, reliable adult working at the Bureau of Anomaly Control! Tiny and Big Kid had an unforgettable adventure that summer! Tiny helped Big Kid better control her Esper Ability! Tiny is Big Kid's most important friend! Tiny and Big Kid will meet again in the future!
Little Mint achieved her dream at summer's end: join BAC and reunite with "Tiny" (who'll be "Tiny Senpai" by then).
Like an ice-cold cola that instantly cools down a stuffy, sweltering summer… her scent awaits in the not-so-distant future.

stories.title: Taste of Everything
stories.text:
The tempting beef tallow base of Panda Hotpot… The sweet and tangy Blizzi Berrie Ice Cream… The bitter yet rich aroma of coffee poured full by Ms. Fei…
Familiar, beloved daily moments write themselves in bold strokes engraved in memory through their scents.
Relax, take a deep breath… feel this moment, the flavors of life flowing gently on the breeze.
